title: Spending - Overview
summary: Understand how EPIC funding is committed, contracted, and spent across the project portfolio.

steps.title: Spending overview
steps.body: The Spending Overview tab is located within the Spending Insight on the Projects page. It helps users understand how EPIC funding is committed, contracted, and spent across the project portfolio.

steps.title: Review funding summary cards
steps.body: At the top, users can see the main funding totals: Committed, Contracted, and Expended. Committed shows total funding allocated, Contracted shows the amount currently under contract, and Expended shows the amount already paid out.

steps.title: View top investment areas
steps.body: The first section shows the top investment areas ordered by committed funding. Click an investment area to open the project list already filtered to that category.

steps.title: Open a filtered investment area
steps.body: For example, click Grid Decarbonization to view projects filtered to that investment area. You can return to the Spending Overview after reviewing the filtered results.

steps.title: Review spending by EPIC period
steps.body: The next section shows spending by EPIC period. Click a period to review the projects connected to that EPIC cycle.

steps.title: Review top project leads
steps.body: The last section shows the top project lead companies ordered by committed funding. Click a company name to view the projects led by that company.
